categories.main_business_segments: Jing-Jin Electric Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and service of new energy vehicle (NEV) electric drive systems. Its core product lines include drive motor assemblies, controller assemblies, transmission assemblies, and related energy storage systems. The company also extends its electric drive technology to electric motorcycles and marine applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies such as high-efficiency motor technology using square conductors and amorphous materials, oil cooling motor technology, integrated motor and transmission systems, and electromagnetic clutch technology. It develops high-power density silicon carbide (SiC) semiconductor controllers and multi-in-one integrated electric drive systems. Production methods emphasize system-level integration, precision mechanical processing, and lean manufacturing with a focus on reducing weight, improving efficiency, and lowering costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jing-Jin Electric serves leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers including Stellantis Group, Ford, China FAW, SAIC, GAC, Chery, Geely, XPeng, BYD, Foton, Zhongtong Bus, and Dongfeng Group. Its products cater to passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, electric motorcycles, and marine electric drive markets. The company targets high-end and mid-to-high-end segments, focusing on both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and R&D bases in Beijing, Shanghai, Zhengding, Heze, Yuyao, and overseas in Detroit, USA. It has a significant presence in North America and Europe, actively expanding its international market footprint. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 48.61% of total revenue in 2023, with notable growth in North American and European markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jing-Jin Electric operates as a core component supplier in the NEV supply chain, positioned as a Tier 1 supplier providing integrated electric drive systems directly to OEMs. It controls upstream R&D and manufacturing of key components such as motors, controllers, and transmissions, enabling system-level integration and optimization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes original, forward-looking R&D focusing on high integration, high power density, and advanced semiconductor technologies like third-generation SiC controllers. It invests heavily in multi-in-one electric drive systems, electromagnetic clutches, oil cooling technologies, and software safety and security. Strategic R&D projects target passenger and commercial vehicle electrification, including heavy-duty electric trucks and integrated electric drive axles, with ongoing efforts to expand into electric motorcycles and marine applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electric drive system products and related technical development and service contracts. Sales recognition occurs upon transfer of control to customers, including direct sales and consignment (consignment revenue recognized upon customer usage). The company also earns income from technology development, mold development, and technical services tied to customer vehicle programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jing-Jin Electric is one of the leading domestic NEV electric drive system suppliers with a strong foothold among top-tier global OEMs. It competes with other major suppliers like BYD (which has stable self-supply) and faces increasing competition from domestic and international suppliers expanding capacity. The company leverages its early market entry, advanced technology, and international certifications to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jing-Jin Electric reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 866.24 million, a 15.13% decrease from the previous year, with net losses attributable to shareholders of RMB -576.94 million, reflecting a 48.56% increase in loss. The company has yet to achieve profitability but continues to invest significantly in R&D (17.32% of revenue) and expand production capacity. Overseas revenue grew by 48.69%, accounting for nearly half of total sales, indicating international market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its industry-leading system-level integration capabilities, combining drive motor, controller, and transmission into highly efficient, lightweight, and compact electric drive systems. Its products feature superior efficiency, power density, noise reduction, and advanced safety functions, supported by proprietary technologies like electromagnetic clutches and oil cooling. Jing-Jin Electric's strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, along with international certifications and global OEM partnerships, differentiate it as a trusted supplier of high-performance electric drive solutions.
